lines.text: Too tired from too much work.
After exams, I felt totally burned out.

data.mean: Too tired from too much work.
data.define: Used when you are worn out after working or studying too long.

example.text: After exams, I felt totally burned out.

misuse.text: Don't say 'burned out' after one busy day.

data.l1_hook: Việc nhiều quá. Tui xong rồi!
data.l1_ex: Sau kỳ thi, tui thấy burned out hoàn toàn.

native.caption:
“burned out” nghĩa là gì?
“burned out” = Cháy sạch năng lượng.
Ví dụ: “After exams, I felt totally burned out.” (Sau kỳ thi, tui thấy burned out hoàn toàn.)
Học tiếng lóng tiếng Anh miễn phí trên Lexkite.
